001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
008 * Limits how many events a route keeps per second, like a token bucket. A burst of up
009 * to <code>maxBurst</code> events is kept, after which events are kept at
010 * <code>rate</code> per second until the burst is earned back. Events more severe
011 * than <code>level</code> are always kept. Time is measured with event timestamps.
012 * <table class="table">
013 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
014 * <tr>
015 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
016 * <th>Type</th>
017 * <th>Required</th>
018 * <th>Default</th>
019 * <th>Description</th>
020 * </tr>
021 * <tr>
022 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.rate" }</code></td>
023 * <td><code>Integer</code></td>
024 * <td><code>true</code></td>
025 * <td>{@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter#DEFAULT_RATE }</td>
026 * <td>Events kept per second once a burst is used up.</td>
027 * </tr>
028 * <tr>
029 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.maxBurst" }</code></td>
030 * <td><code>Integer</code></td>
031 * <td><code>true</code></td>
032 * <td>{@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_BURST }</td>
033 * <td>Events kept at once before the rate applies.</td>
034 * </tr>
035 * <tr>
036 * <td><code>{@index "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.level" }</code></td>
037 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
038 * <td><code>true</code></td>
039 * <td>{@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#WARNING warning}, so errors are always kept</td>
040 * <td>The most severe level that is throttled.</td>
041 * </tr>
042 * </table>
043 */
044public final class ThrottleFilterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<ThrottleFilterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter> {
045
046        /**
047         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
048         * this prefix.
049         */
050        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.";
051        
052        /**
053         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_rate } = java.lang.Integer</code> Events kept per second once a burst is used up.
054         */
055        static final String PROPERTY_rate = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "rate";
056        /**
057         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_maxBurst } = java.lang.Integer</code> Events kept at once before the rate applies.
058         */
059        static final String PROPERTY_maxBurst = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "maxBurst";
060        /**
061         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_level } = java.lang.System.Logger.Level</code> The most severe level that is throttled.
062         */
063        static final String PROPERTY_level = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "level";
064        
065        private final String propertyPrefix;
066        final String property_rate;
067        final String property_maxBurst;
068        final String property_level;
069        
070        private final java.lang.String name;
071        private final java.lang.String filter;
072        private java.lang.Integer rate = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.DEFAULT_RATE;
073        private java.lang.Integer maxBurst = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.DEFAULT_MAX_BURST;
074        private java.lang.System.Logger.Level level = io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.DEFAULT_LEVEL;
075        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable LogMetrics metrics;
076        
077        /**
078         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
079         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.</code>. Route name.
080         * @param filter will fill <code>{filter}</code> in <code>logging.route.{name}.filter.{filter}.</code>. Name the filter is selected with.
081         */
082        public ThrottleFilterBuilder(
083                        java.lang.String name
084                        , java.lang.String filter
085                        ) {
086                try {
087                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
088                                        "name", name
089                                        , "filter", filter
090                                );
091                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
092                        this.name = name;
093                        this.filter = filter;
094                        property_rate = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_rate, prefixParameters);
095                        property_maxBurst = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_maxBurst, prefixParameters);
096                        property_level = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_level, prefixParameters);
097                }
098                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
099                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
100                }
101        }
102
103
104        /**
105         * Sets metrics.
106         * Where to count dropped events as {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics#EVENTS_THROTTLED_METRIC}.
107         * Default is <code>null</code>.
108         * @param metrics not configurable through properties Where to count dropped events as {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogMetrics#EVENTS_THROTTLED_METRIC}.
109         * @return this builder.
110         */
111        public ThrottleFilterBuilder metrics(io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable LogMetrics metrics) {
112                this.metrics = metrics;
113                return this;
114        }
115
116        
117        /**
118         * Sets <strong>required</strong> rate.
119         * Events kept per second once a burst is used up.
120         * Default is {@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter#DEFAULT_RATE }.
121         * @param rate <code>{@value #PROPERTY_rate } = java.lang.Integer</code> Events kept per second once a burst is used up.
122         * @return this builder.
123         */
124        public ThrottleFilterBuilder rate(java.lang.Integer rate) {
125                this.rate = rate;
126                return this;
127        }
128        
129        /**
130         * Sets <strong>required</strong> maxBurst.
131         * Events kept at once before the rate applies.
132         * Default is {@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_BURST }.
133         * @param maxBurst <code>{@value #PROPERTY_maxBurst } = java.lang.Integer</code> Events kept at once before the rate applies.
134         * @return this builder.
135         */
136        public ThrottleFilterBuilder maxBurst(java.lang.Integer maxBurst) {
137                this.maxBurst = maxBurst;
138                return this;
139        }
140        
141        /**
142         * Sets <strong>required</strong> level.
143         * The most severe level that is throttled.
144         * Default is {@link java.lang.System.Logger.Level#WARNING warning}, so errors are always kept.
145         * @param level <code>{@value #PROPERTY_level } = java.lang.System.Logger.Level</code> The most severe level that is throttled.
146         * @return this builder.
147         */
148        public ThrottleFilterBuilder level(java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
149                this.level = level;
150                return this;
151        }
152        
153        /**
154         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter } from this builder.
155         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter }.
156         */
157        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Filter build() {
158                try {
159                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.of(
160                                        this.name
161                                        , this.filter
162                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_rate, this.rate)
163                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_maxBurst, this.maxBurst)
164                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_level, this.level)
165                                        , this.metrics
166                                        );
167                }
168                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
169                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
170                }
171        }
172        
173        @Override
174        public ThrottleFilterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
175                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
176                var _rate = properties.forKey(property_rate).ofInt().or(this.rate).validate(__v);
177                var _maxBurst = properties.forKey(property_maxBurst).ofInt().or(this.maxBurst).validate(__v);
178                var _level = properties.forKey(property_level).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.ThrottleFilter.parseLevel(_v)).or(this.level).validate(__v);
179                __v.validate();
180                this.rate = _rate.value();
181                this.maxBurst = _maxBurst.value();
182                this.level = _level.value();
183                return this;
184        }
185        
186        /**
187         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
188         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
189         */
190        @Override
191        public String propertyPrefix() {
192                return this.propertyPrefix;
193        }
194        
195}
